parameters.text:
=Extract all tax-relevant information from this {{ $('Set Doc Meta').item.json.doc_type }} document.

Country: {{ $('Set Doc Meta').item.json.country }}
Tax Year: {{ $('Set Doc Meta').item.json.tax_year }}

Document:
{{ $json.data }}

Extract:
1. All income sources with amounts
2. All deductions claimed
3. Tax already deducted (TDS)
4. Employer/payer details
5. PAN/Tax ID numbers
6. Any missing information

Return JSON:
{
  "document_type": "",
  "taxpayer_name": "",
  "pan": "",
  "tax_year": "",
  "income_sources": [{"source": "", "amount": 0, "type": "salary/business/capital_gains/other"}],
  "gross_income": 0,
  "deductions": [{"section": "", "description": "", "amount": 0}],
  "total_deductions": 0,
  "taxable_income": 0,
  "tds_deducted": 0,
  "tax_payable": 0,
  "refund_due": 0,
  "missing_info": [],
  "action_items": []
}

=Based on this tax data for {{ $('Set Doc Meta').item.json.country }}, calculate the final tax position and provide specific advice.

Tax Data: {{ JSON.stringify($json) }}
Tax Year: {{ $('Set Doc Meta').item.json.tax_year }}

Provide:
1. Final tax payable or refund amount
2. Additional deductions they could still claim
3. Tax saving opportunities for next year
4. Filing deadline and requirements
5. Any red flags or audit risks

Return JSON:
{
  "final_position": "refund/payable/nil",
  "amount": 0,
  "additional_deductions_possible": [{"section": "", "max_amount": 0, "description": ""}],
  "next_year_tips": [],
  "filing_deadline": "",
  "audit_risks": [],
  "plain_summary": "2-3 sentence plain English summary"
}

parameters.content:
## FLOOWBOX - Tax Document Processor
Send any tax document URL (Form 16, salary slips, capital gains statement).
GPT-4o extracts: income sources, deductions, TDS, tax payable/refund.
Second pass identifies additional deductions still claimable.
Saves full analysis to Notion + email report.

DISCLAIMER: Always verify with a CA before filing.
